note: What each fragment must do, read by browser-checks/wasi_run.mjs (verify.sh's Swift gate). `sdk` is the standard library compile.py must choose: embedded, or full when Embedded Swift cannot compile the fragment (03: String.contains(String)) or would print its placeholder (05: an [Int] in a string, 09: an error in a string). `trap` means the program must end by trapping, `fatal` the text its output must hold when it does, `withinSeconds` how soon. Every other fragment must exit 0 with its .expected as its output; `transcript` is what the page shows with the input echoed (the prompt BEFORE the echoed line, though the prompt has no newline: readLine() flushes first).
